name: VillaBake
address: 4799 Palm Ave, Hialeah, FL 33012, United States

reviewSamples.texto: We came all the way from Costa Rica to try their desserts, and they did not disappoint! Everything was delicious, especially the Coconut Cuban Cake
We had such a wonderful experience with Villabake! They made my son's birthday cake, and it turned out absolutely beautiful.
Place looks super clean and the staff is very kind. All the sweets we ordered were great. An authentic Cuban Pastry shop
